text:
• one head unifies two task types;
  simple, reusable design

• careful latency protocol: generative
  baselines also reuse the video prefix

• controlled comparison with
  autoregressive SFT on the same data

• models and code released

• closed set: someone must supply the candidates;
  one contiguous span per query only

• QA training data is internal; gains partly from data
  (scoring adds +1.3 / +1.9 over autoregressive SFT)

• latency excludes video decoding and preprocessing,
  which also cost time in real systems

• Joint inference: later questions see earlier ones;
  order effects are not studied

• overconfident probabilities (ECE ≈ 8 points)

• 'System One' comes from a vendor blog
